mapper.select: SELECT b.id, u.name, b.title, b.category, b.created_at, -- 댓글 수 (SELECT count(*) FROM board_comments bc WHERE bc.board_id = b.id) AS commentCount, -- 저장된 이미지 (SELECT stored_filename FROM board_images bi WHERE bi.board_id = b.id LIMIT 1) AS image FROM boards b join users u on b.user_id = u.id ORDER BY b.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boards(user_id, track_id, title, content, category) VALUES (#{userId}, #{trackId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{title}, #{content}, #{category})
mapper.update: UPDATE boards SET title = #{board.title}, content = #{board.content}, category = #{board.category}, updated_at = DEFAULT WHERE id = #{id}
